model.marketing_data_platform.int_market.name: int_marketing_ads
model.marketing_data_platform.int_market.description: Facebook and Snapchat ad performance in one structure. One row per platform, per ad, per day.

model.marketing_data_platform.int_facebo.name: int_facebook_ads_daily
model.marketing_data_platform.int_facebo.description: Facebook ad performance with campaign name and currency attached. One row per ad per day.

model.marketing_data_platform.int_snapch.name: int_snapchat_ads_daily
model.marketing_data_platform.int_snapch.description: Snapchat ad performance with campaign name attached, summed across countries. One row per ad per day. Country is dropped here so the grain matches Facebook.

model.marketing_data_platform.dim_campai.name: dim_campaign
model.marketing_data_platform.dim_campai.description: Campaigns across Facebook and Snapchat. One row per platform, per campaign. Only campaigns that have performance rows appear here.

model.marketing_data_platform.fct_market.name: fct_marketing_spend
model.marketing_data_platform.fct_market.description: Daily advertising performance across Facebook and Snapchat. One row per platform, per ad, per day. Spend is in the row's own currency, so group by currency_code before summing spend.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.name: stg_facebook_account
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.description: Cleaned Facebook ad accounts. One row per ad account. Types are standardised; no business logic is applied here.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.name: stg_facebook_ads
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.description: Facebook ads (creatives). One row per ad. Links each ad to its campaign, ad group and account.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.name: stg_facebook_ad_group
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.description: Facebook ad groups. One row per ad group. Holds the targeting label for each group of ads.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.name: stg_facebook_campaign
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_facebo.description: Facebook campaigns. One row per campaign. Provides the campaign name used for reporting.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.name: stg_snapchat_ads_campaign
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.description: Snapchat campaigns. One row per campaign, to be confirmed by a uniqueness check. Provides the campaign name and the owning account.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.name: stg_snapchat_ads_stats
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.description: Daily Snapchat ad performance. One row per ad per country per day. Clicks stored as the text 'null' in the source are converted to real nulls.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.name: stg_snapchat_ad_group
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.description: Snapchat ad groups (ad squads). One row per ad group, to be confirmed by a uniqueness check. Links each ad group to its campaign.

model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.name: stg_snapchat_ad_history
model.marketing_data_platform.stg_snapch.description: Snapchat ads (creatives). One row per ad, confirmed by a uniqueness check. Links each ad to its ad group.

source.marketing_data_platform.facebook_.name: facebook_ad_group

source.marketing_data_platform.facebook_.name: facebook_ads

source.marketing_data_platform.facebook_.name: facebook_ads_stats

source.marketing_data_platform.snapchat_.name: snapchat_ads_stats

source.marketing_data_platform.snapchat_.name: snapchat_ad_history

    from `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`fct_marketing_spend`

),

parent as (
    select campaign_key as to_field

        WHEN clicks IS NULL OR clicks = 0 THEN NULL

    END
 AS cpc,
    
    CASE

        ELSE spend * 1000 / impressions
    END
 AS cpm

WITH stats AS (

    SELECT * FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads_stats`

),

ads AS (

    SELECT ad_id, campaign_id FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_facebook_ads`

),

campaigns AS (

    SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_facebook_campaign`

),

accounts AS (

    SELECT account_id, ad_currency_code FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_facebook_account`

)

SELECT
    'facebook' AS platform,
    stats.ad_id,
    stats.report_date,
    ads.campaign_id,
    campaigns.campaign_name,
    accounts.ad_currency_code AS currency_code,
    CAST(stats.spend AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS spend,
    stats.impressions,
    stats.clicks,
    stats.clicks IS NOT NULL AS is_clicks_reported
FROM stats
LEFT JOIN ads ON stats.ad_id = ads.ad_id
LEFT JOIN campaigns ON ads.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
LEFT JOIN accounts ON stats.account_id = accounts.account_id

WITH stats_by_day AS (

    SELECT
        ad_id,
        report_date,
        currency_code,
        SUM(spend) AS spend,
        SUM(impressions) AS impressions,
        SUM(clicks) AS clicks,
        COUNT(clicks) = COUNT(*) AS is_clicks_reported
    FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ads_stats`
    GROUP BY ad_id, report_date, currency_code

),

ads AS (

    SELECT ad_id, ad_group_id FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ad_history`

),

ad_groups AS (

    SELECT ad_group_id, campaign_id FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ad_group`

),

campaigns AS (

    SELECT campaign_id, campaign_name FROM `bronze_staging`.`marketing_ads_staging`.`stg_snapchat_ads_campaign`

)

SELECT
    'snapchat' AS platform,
    stats_by_day.ad_id,
    stats_by_day.report_date,
    ad_groups.campaign_id,
    campaigns.campaign_name,
    stats_by_day.currency_code,
    CAST(stats_by_day.spend AS DECIMAL(18, 6)) AS spend,
    stats_by_day.impressions,
    stats_by_day.clicks,
    stats_by_day.is_clicks_reported
FROM stats_by_day
LEFT JOIN ads ON stats_by_day.ad_id = ads.ad_id
LEFT JOIN ad_groups ON ads.ad_group_id = ad_groups.ad_group_id
LEFT JOIN campaigns ON ad_groups.campaign_id = campaigns.campaign_id
